S108.01.needs: a signed-in account; a linked bank to see balances (bank stays off per owner)
S108.01.note: The Finances page has no sidebar or menu entry in the code; it is opened by URL or by the See your finances action after a bank link. Plaid is not live, so balances may not appear.

Type /chat/finance in the browser address bar and press Enter.
Look for the heading Finances, then the Accounts section.
Compare the accounts and the total under Spending with the Expected line: accounts, balances and spending in one view.
S108.01.where: Address bar > /chat/finance, then the heading Finances (no sidebar entry)
